propositions: Push non-fast-forward recovery in _recover_dirty_merge fails when untracked local files collide with files the merge wants to create, with no retry mechanism to self-heal like reconverge does
Colliding untracked files must be quarantined into a shared directory and the merge retried once before aborting, preserving stash-restored tracked edits on all exit paths

The recovery must reuse sync's shared parser (_untracked_overwrite_paths) for identifying abort-named paths and share the quarantine directory path shape while using push_recovery's own mover through core._git to respect test monkeypatching
Genuine merge conflicts and paths git does not name must keep today's abort behavior unchanged; the quarantine directory is only created when files are moved
Stash commit object must be restored exactly once on every code path: success, retry-failure, and non-recoverable abort
